_README: Webhooks come from the GitHub repo Secret DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions). Leave the fields below empty. Never paste a webhook into this file in a PUBLIC repo.

settings._noise_k_note: Call only if |gap| >= noise_k * sigma_per_min * sqrt(minutes_left). Raise to be pickier.
settings._dry_run_note: true = don't post to Discord. The workflow sets this to false automatically when the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret exists.
settings._call_marks_note: ONE call per round, at minute 1. The band is scaled to the ~14 min still to run, and a directional call is only emitted when the gap clears conviction_gate_k x that band AND the technicals agree AND the asset's own history does not argue against it. Expect many NO CALLs.
settings._conviction_gate_note: Multiple of the noise band the gap must clear before a directional call is allowed.
